name: Ritz-Carlton Central Park
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park, a hotel on Central Park South in Midtown Manhattan
best_for: Travelers who want to be next to Central Park and Fifth Avenue
Families who want a kids program and suites with dining rooms

facts.text: The hotel sits on the doorstep of Central Park.
The hotel is steps from Museum Mile, home to the Met, MoMA and the Guggenheim.
Fifth Avenue is just steps from the hotel.
The spa offers Swiss skincare and personalized treatments.
Contour is the hotel's restaurant and bar, with a social dining concept of handcrafted cocktails and crafted dishes.
The Club Lounge is described as a hotel within a hotel, with a private lounge and a dedicated concierge.
The Artists' Gate Suite has 13 windows with views of Central Park from the third floor.
The Movement Studio offers virtual on-demand classes from yoga and Pilates to high-intensity interval training.

highlights.text: The hotel's accommodations overlook the route of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
The Royal Suite has handcrafted wood accents, a curated collection of artwork and panoramic views of Central Park.
Young guests have a dedicated check-in area, a welcome toy, special dining options, and sweets and games in the Club Lounge through the Ritz Kids program.
The Manhattan Minute at the Contour Bar Room is a take on the traditional happy hour that teaches the history of the Manhattan cocktail and sends guests home with a recipe card.
The concierges are members of Les Clefs d'Or, the global association of hotel concierges.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
Breakfast is available at Contour for a fee.
